purpose: Establish why the authoritative CPU terrain has its measured latency and cost, exhaust measured standard CPU improvements, and retain a stable final CPU baseline before any GPU architecture decision is eligible.

authority_policy.correctness_precedence: No performance result may weaken topology, LOD seams, edits, collision, persistence, determinism, bounded ownership, or fail-closed behavior.
authority_policy.gpu_policy: Passing this precondition permits a measured GPU architecture decision; it does not assume GPU promotion or revoke CPU authority.

qualification_boundary.hardware: Intel 4-core host and NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 Max-Q
qualification_boundary.reason: The development host must retain one logical CPU outside terrain qualification work for system stability.

cpu_release.claim: Final authoritative CPU correctness, attribution, and architecture baseline under a three-logical-CPU qualification ceiling; production responsiveness goals remain separate.

ordered_closure.title: Bottleneck Attribution And Benchmark Integrity
complete_when: Non-intrusive process CPU and boundary RSS telemetry passes the same correctness workload.
Nine scenarios separate wall time, process CPU, native phases, queue wait, publication, collision, frame pacing, and responsiveness.
At least 300 frames per scenario provide multiple p99-tail samples.
Debug/editor, release-native editor-host, and true 4.7.1 release-runtime modes remain distinct.
Every promotable run records and enforces the three-logical-CPU affinity.

ordered_closure.title: Measured Standard CPU Architecture Work
complete_when: Generation and meshing worker counts one through three are swept under identical three-core workloads.
Bounded prepare, execute, and complete meshing workers preserve priorities, cancellation, stale rejection, and immutable ownership.
Two generation workers and two meshing workers are selected from wall time, CPU work, memory, queues, and frame tails.
Collision remains spatially targeted and generation-aware.
Native, Godot, topology, LOD, edit, persistence, determinism, memory, and shutdown regressions pass.

ordered_closure.title: Final CPU Baseline And Exhaustion Review
complete_when: Production responsiveness targets are explicit and evaluated independently from correctness safety gates.
Low-power, balanced, quality, and reference release-runtime profiles each have three comparable repetitions.
Every remaining material bottleneck has a retained classification.
Power-provider absences remain explicit and prevent CPU-package or whole-system watt claims.
An independent fail-closed report records TQP-58 eligibility without changing CPU authority.

low_power.recommendation: Use only when reduced concurrency is more important than arrival latency.

balanced.recommendation: Best measured balance of wall time, CPU work, memory, and frame tails under the three-core ceiling.

quality.recommendation: Correct but not the default; higher contention and frame tails provide no baseline advantage.

reference.recommendation: Use for reference-oriented comparison, not as a speed claim.

production_responsiveness_targets.policy: Goals are evaluated from the median of three final balanced repetitions and do not weaken correctness safety gates.

remaining_bottleneck_classification.basis: Two workers beat one; three increased wall time, memory, and tails under the three-core ceiling.
Prepare/execute/complete workers are implemented; two workers are selected because three did not improve wall time and worsened p99.
Completion validates and publishes authoritative immutable pages on the control path; two attempted shortcuts were measured and rejected.
Publication and collision phase time are small relative to storage and meshing; collision remains local and generation-aware.
CPU time and active-core equivalents are retained, but no trusted CPU-package or whole-system energy provider exists.

historical_excluded_evidence.reason: The runs failed their own frame-tail gates and predate the three-logical-CPU boundary.
Both preserved correctness but failed to improve the matched baseline and were reverted.

known_target_misses: Sustained 60 Hz p99 frame pacing is not achieved on the declared host.
Several relocation first-visual and settlement targets are not achieved.
High-speed-flight collision coherence narrowly misses the 100 ms goal.
No CPU-package or whole-system watt target can be evaluated without a trusted provider.

power_boundaries.gpu_board: nvidia-smi board power is GPU context only
power_boundaries.cpu_package: requires a trusted package-energy provider; must not be inferred from GPU-board power
power_boundaries.whole_system: requires a wall, DC-input, or platform telemetry provider; must remain separate
power_boundaries.promotion_without_cpu_package_sensor: CPU time, wall time, work throughput, active-core equivalents, and frame pacing may qualify architecture readiness, but no CPU-watt or whole-system-watt claim may be made.

invalid_promotion_evidence: A correctness-only PASS with multi-second timeouts
A single run or a run that failed its own correctness or frame gate
A report without the exact three-logical-CPU affinity
A benchmark with changed world, LOD, collision, edit, or visual workload
GPU-board watts relabelled as CPU-package or whole-system watts
Higher throughput obtained by stale work, missing collision, topology regressions, fallbacks, or weakened authority
